The periodic pass of the signed sensor channels (lookup flags 2, cm848_signedFirstOrderFilter; lha loads): read the QADC result, linearize, filter, debounce the high / low faults, write the outputs. Its callers run from periodic tasks; the old name said configInit (was sensorChannelConfigInit)

The boot pass of the signed sensor channels: seeds the filter accumulator, resets the lookup cache to 2 and points the filter at the config's coefficient. Its callers run once from cm848_applicationMain (was updateSensorChannelWithConfig)

The periodic pass of the unsigned sensor channels (lookup flags 0, exponentialMovingAverage; lhz loads). Unlike the signed twin it skips the threshold faults of channel 47 (cruise switch) until cruise_control_switches_learned_flag, of channel 71 (A/C pressure) until its learned flag, and of channel 10 (oil pressure) while oil_pressure_switch_only_cal is set (was sensorChannelTypeB_configInit) | earlier note: review-function-readability reviewed 2026-06-12 - Readability MEDIUM (irreducible converging-epilogue gotos + 3 split-remnant scratch temps Ghidra will not let CSV name) Accuracy Confidence High. config_ptr typed as sensor_channel_config_t* (7 default/threshold/debounce fields render); DAT_003fd8e8 -> governor_temp_protection_disable (now oil_pressure_switch_only_cal); 11 locals named; 2 array globals renamed. 13-param PowerPC prototype; params 4-6 passed but unused.
